subject: Immutable transport key-lineage attestation request
messages:
From: Danny Ruiz <danny.ruiz@novabank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: transport key-lineage immutability attestation and sampling

Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the time on Friday. As we prepare our SIG intake, the audit team has a narrow follow-up: they want an attestation that the transport keys used for inter-service envelope wrapping are immutable across operator shifts (i.e., no unrecorded rewraps) plus a small sampling of shift logs and key lineage records to validate.

Specifically we need: 
- A signed attestation (PDF) describing the immutability controls for transport keys (wrapping/unwrapping events and who can trigger them).
- A 72-hour sampling of HSM shift logs with any rewrap events highlighted (redact operator PII if necessary).
- A CSV extract showing key lineage for the wrapping KEKs over the last 90 days (key_id, parent_key, wrapped_at, wrapped_by, wrap_tool).

Our deadline for the SIG upload is 2026-08-28 COB. Can you confirm feasibility and any constraints (redaction, sample size, delivery method)?

Thanks,
Danny
Danny Ruiz
Senior InfoSec Engineer — Nova Bank
security@novabank.com

[Attachment: sig-ask-20260820.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Danny Ruiz <danny.ruiz@novabank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: transport key-lineage immutability attestation and sampling

Hi Danny — thanks, can do. Quick clarifying notes so we scope the deliverables correctly: 

1) Attestation scope: We have a standard signed immutability attestation for transport KEKs that covers operator separation, HSM-backed wrapping, and sealed-log retention. If you need customer-facing language or a replacement of any Redwood template wording, let us know.

2) HSM shift logs: We can provide a 72-hour sample from our HSM shift logs. We will redact operator email addresses but keep operator IDs and timestamps. Is that acceptable, or do you require full unredacted operator identities under an NDA?

3) Key lineage CSV: We can produce a 90-day lineage extract. It will include internal wrap_tool identifiers (e.g., wrapd-v2), key_ids (kek-xxxxx), parent_key, wrapped_at (ISO), and wrapped_by (operator_id). We can additionally include a high-level checksum column to show immutability (sha256 over record).

4) Delivery: Preferred path is our secure Drive link and DocuSign for the attestation signature. We can also push logs via SFTP if you prefer.

Target timeline: deliver the attestation and CSV by 2026-08-25 EOD and the HSM shift log sample by 2026-08-26 EOD. That should give you a day to finalize the SIG upload. If you need everything sooner we can reprioritize.

I'll loop in Irene (EncryptOps) to extract and redact logs. Marissa — can you confirm who signs the attestation on our side? We typically use our Head of InfoSec or the KMS owner.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Liaison — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood-immutability-template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Danny Ruiz <danny.ruiz@novabank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-24T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: transport key-lineage immutability attestation and sampling

Jonas — thanks for the clear plan. A few follow-ups from audit: 
- Redacted operator IDs are fine, we only need continuity and a way to tie operator_id back to a shift window (no PII).
- For the attestation signer, Head of InfoSec is preferred.
- For the lineage CSV, please include the sha256 checksum column as you suggested.
- Delivery via secure Drive + DocuSign is fine. We will provide a temporary SFTP if needed for the HSM snippet.

If you can target the attestation + CSV by EOD 2026-08-25, that meets our upload window. Thanks again — small ask but high impact for our SIG submission.

—Danny

Subject: Re: Request: transport key-lineage immutability attestation and sampling — delivery

Danny — delivering the requested artifacts today. Attached: 
- signed-immutability-attestation.pdf (signed by Head of InfoSec)
- transport-keylineage-sample.csv (90-day extract with sha256 checksum column)
- hsm-shiftlog-snippet.txt (72-hour sample, operator IDs retained, PII redacted)

Notes / caveats: 
- The attestation references our HSM-backed key wrapping process (KM v3) and operator separation controls. If you require additional CAIQ-specific language (e.g., explicit CAIQ control IDs), tell us and we can issue a short addendum.
- The lineage CSV includes internal wrap_tool identifiers. If you need mapping to a public name, we can add a mapping table.
- We produced an incremental audit checksum (manifest.sha256) you can use to verify file integrity; manifest included in Drive link.

Delivery links: 
- Secure Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/KT-Lineage/novabank-sample
- DocuSign: https://docusign.com/rec/ABC123456789 (attestation signature trace)

If audit needs anything else (e.g., larger time window, unredacted operator identities under NDA), let us know and we'll coordinate with legal.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Security Liaison — Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
